upgrades: Mounts (Horse, Pegasus, Royal Griffon, Imperial Dragon)

Keywords.Hold the Line: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
Keywords.Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
Keywords.Caster Group: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit.
Keywords.Furious: Whenever this unit charges, it gets +1 hit for each unmodified hit roll of 6.
Keywords.Tough(X): This model must take X wounds before being killed.

Army Spells.Aura of Heroism (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Enhanced Hold the Line once.
Army Spells.Spirit Leech (1): Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1).
Army Spells.Magic Targeting (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once.
Army Spells.Fire Ball (2): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 4 hits with Fracture.
Army Spells.Elemental Form (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get AP(+1) in melee once.
Army Spells.Blood Hex (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 9 hits.
